Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Changed physical prize inventory to first-collector availability instead of reserving stock by queue age. Any verified winner whose exact prize quantity is currently in Porter's bags can now collect first, even when another member has an older awaiting win for the same item. Dashboard ownership, recipient verification, atomic delivery records, and post-trade stock recalculation remain enforced.
